highlights_headline: Upcoming 4.156 updates correct clipped paths, glyph replay, and Graphite pixel readback without changing managed APIs.

bullets.lead: More robust path rasterization and clipping
bullets.detail: Corrects convex-path rasterization at clip boundaries and guards against fixed-point overflow and invalid run lengths. Also fixes Ganesh path bounds and coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds.

Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds, and flags, preserves creation-time rounding during direct-mask replay, and bounds mask offsets. Retains rendering fallbacks when glyph data or atlas filtering is unsuitable.
Uses an opaque RGBA destination when reading an alpha texture into an RGBx color type, preventing incorrect row stepping and unwritten pixel bytes.
